adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `actions.next`/`previous` optimistically mutate the model via `group.set("offset", offset)` before the async `group.findMembers()` completes. `currentPage`/`showingFirst`/`showingLast` are computed from `offset`/`limit`/`user_count` (proxied from the model by the `ObjectController`), while the displayed list comes from `members`, which is only updated inside `Group#findMembers()`'s AJAX `.then(...)`. Since there is no error handling/rollback path on the returned promise, an AJAX failure would leave `offset` updated but `members`/`user_count` potentially stale, desynchronizing pagination UI from the member list.
